question: Ustad Zakir Hussain is the son of ____________, an Indian tabla player.
solution:
The correct answer is **Ustad Alla Rakha **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• He is popularly known as** Alla Rakha,** was an **Indian tabla player who specialized in Hindustani classical music**.
 
• He was a frequent accompanist of **sitar player Pandit Ravi Shankar **and was largely responsible for introducing **Tabla **to the western audience.
 
• **Alla Rakha** left his home at age 12 to learn tabla under the great master (ustad) Mian Qadir Baksh. 
 
• He also trained under** Ashik Ali Khan,** a vocalist admired especially for his mastery of the **khayal Hindustani** song repertoire​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan** is popularly known as the** “Sarod Samrat“. **He is the sixth generation sarod player in his family​
 
• **Imrat khan **was an **Indian sitar and surbahar player and composer**. 
 
• **Ustad Faiyaz khan** was an** Indian classical vocalist, an exponent of the Agra Gharana of Hindustani Classical music.**
